overview: A dark scientific lab where a real artificial life simulation runs in the browser: plants, herbivores and predators with heritable genomes and neural networks evolve through natural selection.
features: Live 2D ecosystem with plants, herbivores, predators, zones and decaying corpses
Genomes and small heritable neural networks that drive each organism's behavior
Pause, step, 1x to 25x speed and fast-forward a chosen number of cycles
Zoomable, pannable canvas with selection, hover info, trails and vision ranges
Organism inspector with genes, neural network, ancestors and descendants
Population dashboard, live charts and an evolution timeline from real data
Environment controls and five experiment events
Save experiments and snapshots after sign-in and admin approval, with seeded replay
JSON and CSV export, JSON import and overlay comparison of two experiments
